name: Ptukh Landing
notes: Beware of barbed wire. There is a barbed wire fence around every plot of farm land to keep the livestock out. I landed on the road into Ptukh. Scope your landing location in advance. Make your desires to fly known to the locals, and don't land in their cropped fields. The valley breeze blows west to east once it gets going. Mornings are calm and good for sleddies.
